assumptions: bytes_measured = compressed stored parquet bytes for jetta days (post-decode), raw .bi5 wire bytes for fallback days
ticks/day extrapolated from the in-range pilot days only (2026-10-20 excluded; it is the probe-overlap day)
weekend/holiday days cost a cheap empty response but are still counted in request_chunks_estimate
jetta API rate limit 8 req/s (package default) puts a hard floor on full-range wall time
dukascopy-downloader is resumable (per-chunk manifest), so the range can be fetched across sessions
storage size = the store's per-day parquet files as measured in this pilot

method_notes: spread_pips=(ask-bid)/0.0001; p99=linear-interpolation quantile; share_of_day=time-weighted: ms-span of ticks with spread<=1.0 pip divided by ms-span from first to last tick of the UTC day
